android.versioning_policy: semantic version name; monotonically increasing integer version code

release_signing.secret_transport: environment variables / protected CI secrets only

completion_requirements: application id accepted by distribution console
release keystore generated and backed up outside repository
signed release AAB produced and signature verified
note: The stable application id is persisted early because changing it after store publication creates a different Android application. 12.2 remains in progress until real release signing and console acceptance are proven.
